scope.claim: Retrospective synthetic injections on measured backgrounds; not independent new astronomy or physical origin labels.

routing: Reacquire original 176 exact hashed tiles and regenerate identical frozen Minimal inference. Replay original C and R41S1B advisory traces for every alert; assert exact trace ancestry and baseline masks. Apply all three diagnostic operators to every qualified alert, no y, truth, amplitude, target-specific routing or archived residual identifiers. Unsupported or unqualified remain unchanged. No veto, ranking, fitting, tuning, Penrose or decision changes.

operators.morphology: Compare primary candidate and independently selected repeat paths: ridge-aligned frequency profiles +/-12, positive excess width proxy, core vs shoulders, active fraction, temporal half means, profile cosine and time-profile Pearson (undefined if zero norm or constant). ON and OFF separately; shape agreement not physical identity. Primary uses injected test spectrum; repeat measured raw. No resampling or padding.
operators.trajectory: On second ON and OFF separately search full frozen R35B path shapes translated to legal 208-channel halo. On first 8 rows select exact best canonical path; evaluate on held-out last 8; then reverse. Compare to fixed receiver candidate. Clipped contrast [-4,4], canonical ties. Record held-out gains, consensus, signed frequency offsets, slope Hz/s, curvature, boundary flags, ON/OFF agreement. No physical extrapolation across gaps. Count search multiplicity, maximum not p-value.
operators.instrument: Per-scan robust normalized >3 occupancy, fraction of channels with >50% rows above 3, row common-mode occupancy, narrow core vs shoulders and width, persistent ON/OFF channel occupancy Jaccard, ON/OFF selected-path agreement. Proxies only, not confirmed RFI classifications.

controls: Independent synthetic holdout seed 413101, 32 base noise realizations per class: noise, narrow drifting, broad burst, shared stationary instrument proxy. Matched independent repeat scan pairs, injection 8 robust units, 20-bin shift, 16 rows, broad width 17. Report predefined feature distributions by simulated class; no training. Synthetic control class is not actual instrument identity.
evaluation: Fixed feature names; AUC control=1 as retrospective descriptive effect size, per-target median only where both classes exist; correlated paired rows not independent. Fit/audit separately, parent/rescue, missingness and denominator; no winning feature or threshold chosen. Synthetic controls separate. Verify archive SHA and 22 trace hashes, exact replay, append content-addressed diagnostic state. Record network, CPU, wall, memory. No new stress claim.
gate: PASS R1 diagnostic engineering only: archive/22 traces verified, 11 exact baseline and first/second replay, 891 qualified diagnostics; template plus morphology/instrument simulation gate; full bank separate status; zero alert/hit changes. No promotion of v1 or scientific adoption.

amendment.reason: Free full-bank different shapes can agree with training half yet fail extrapolation to the other half. Add separate physically interpretable translation-only family of the already selected candidate path. No threshold relaxation or replacement of failed full-bank result. Full bank diagnostic still reported, not promoted.
amendment.method: For each ON/OFF repeat scan enumerate all integer shifts k of frozen candidate p satisfying every bin in [5,202]; use the exact same disjoint half fit/other-half score and canonical ties. Fixed-path score and full-bank outputs unchanged. Report independently both families, shift agreement, signed shift Hz, held-out gain; no choosing one by held-out scores.
amendment.gate: New seed synthetic gate tests positive shifted-narrow template heldout gain, broad occupancy > narrow, shared OFF fixed > narrow. Full-bank direction check remains an explicitly separate diagnostic; failure not declared recovered. No mask changes; historical screen remains HOLD. Original v1 remains failed. Diagnostic only; no external claim.
